sections.heading: Jennifer Lopez — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Jennifer Lopez was born on 24 July 1969 in The Bronx, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Jennifer Lynn Lopez at birth and is publicly known as Jennifer Lopez.
Public records name her father, David López and her mother, Guadalupe Rodríguez. She is a sibling of Lynda Lopez.
She is recorded as speaking English and Spanish.
